title: Run an AI-native ops team
description: Wake up to a sorted inbox, a daily brief, and meetings that follow up on themselves. Strawberry handles the small things across every tab.
introduction: Ops work is a thousand small things across a hundred tabs: the inbox, the calendar, the project tool, and the vendor portal that logs you out every single week.
Strawberry works in all of them, right in the browser, and it remembers where things stand. The small things get done, and you get to work on the things only you can do.

items.title: Wake up to a sorted inbox

blocks.text: Not sure where to start? Your companion can look at the work you have open and suggest the first thing worth handing over.

skill.context: Ask your companion to look at your work and suggest the first thing to hand over.

sections.title: Wake up to a sorted inbox

blocks.text: A morning Routine labels everything the way you like it, archives the obvious junk, and tells you the three messages that actually matter today. If the inbox is thousands deep, it helps you clear the bulk first and then works through the rest with you.

sections.title: Start the day with a brief

blocks.text: Today's meetings with the context you need, what's waiting on you, and what changed overnight, in one short note before your first coffee.

sections.title: Meetings that follow up on themselves

blocks.text: Strawberry's transcription logs the meeting without a bot joining the call. Afterwards, the action items go to the right people and the notes land where the team will find them.
Promises made in meetings and threads have a way of disappearing. Strawberry finds the ones nobody followed up on and drafts the nudge.
Strawberry logs in to vendor portals and billing pages to fetch the invoices that never arrive by email, then puts them in a register with a link to every original, ready for your bookkeeper.

items: Write the weekly status update from project tools, meetings, and messages.
Plan and book a trip or an event, comparing real options in the browser and booking only what you approve.
Onboard a new teammate: accounts, docs to read, and people to meet.
Create Slack channels and invite the right people, instead of doing it by hand every time.

blocks.text: The team workspace gives everyone, people and companions, one shared place for notes, docs, and handoffs. What one companion learns about how the company runs, the others can use.
Put the recurring parts on Routines and they keep happening when someone is on holiday. Ops stops depending on who remembered.
